text.p: Flood waters are receding and clean up efforts beginning in the northern Plains of the US. Flooding continues in Winnipeg, Manitoba but should gradually improve over the next few days. No widespread rains are expected early this week with only a few light showers expected.

Tropical Cyclone June (35P) is in the southern Pacific near 16.6s/177.7e or just north-northwest of Fiji, moving southeast at 9 mph. June will threaten shipping and boating and could bring locally heavy squalls and gusty winds to the northern Fiji Islands over the next 12 hours before beginning a gradual weakening trend. The system will likely be dissipated by 48-60 hours.
There are no further statements at this time.
